options.name: approval
options.description: Approval status of the catalog request. Default choices are C(requested), C(approved), C(rejected), C(not_requested).

options.name: assigned_to
options.description: User assigned to handle this catalog request. Expected value is user login name (user_name field).

options.name: assignment_group
options.description: The name of the group that the catalog request is assigned to.

options.name: attachments
options.description: ServiceNow attachments.

options.name: catalog_request_mapping
options.description: User mappings for I(catalog_request) states and fields

options.name: comments
options.description: Additional comments for the catalog request.

options.name: delivery_plan
options.description: Delivery plan for the catalog request.

options.name: delivery_task
options.description: Delivery task for the catalog request.

options.name: description
options.description: Detailed description of the catalog request.

options.name: due_date
options.description: Expected due date for the catalog request. Expected format is YYYY-MM-DD.

options.name: impact
options.description: Impact of the catalog request. Default choices are C(1), C(2), C(3). Impact 1 is the highest, 3 is the lowest impact.

options.name: instance
options.description: ServiceNow instance information.

options.name: number
options.description: Number of the record to operate on. Note that contrary to I(sys_id), I(number) may not uniquely identify a record.

options.name: other
options.description: Optional remaining parameters. For more information on optional parameters, refer to the ServiceNow catalog request documentation.

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority of the catalog request. Default choices are C(1), C(2), C(3), C(4), C(5). Priority 1 is the highest, 5 is the lowest priority.

options.name: request_state
options.description: The current state of the catalog request. Default choices are C(draft), C(submitted), C(in_process), C(delivered), C(cancelled), C(closed_incomplete), C(closed_complete), C(closed_cancelled).

options.name: requested_by
options.description: User who requested the catalog item. Expected value is user login name (user_name field).

options.name: requested_for
options.description: User who the catalog item is being requested for. Expected value is user login name (user_name field).

options.name: short_description
options.description: Brief summary of the catalog request.

options.name: stage
options.description: Current stage of the catalog request. Default choices are C(request_approved), C(fulfillment), C(delivery), C(completed).

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the catalog request. If I(state) value is C(present), the record is created or updated. If I(state) value is C(absent), the record is deleted. Default choices are C(present) and C(absent).

options.name: sys_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the record to operate on.

options.name: urgency
options.description: Urgency of the catalog request. Default choices are C(1), C(2), C(3). Urgency 1 is the highest, 3 is the lowest urgency.

options.name: work_notes
options.description: Work notes for the catalog request (internal notes).
